review: bounded-resource-search@1 (handler long.bounded-resource-search, scope long-ex26, learning 1 with no study energy, prerequisites and dependencies navigate, probe and gather, references {} since no parameter names a target, visualComponents [] with view metadata on every event) is a multi-round work record under bounded-resource-search:work:open that takes exactly one dependency step per round through the dependency's own code and nothing else: the kernel navigate step (v7NavigateStep, the unchanged kernel.navigate function of foundation-forest@1, now also exported, with no behavior change), the observe mode of OPEN_FOUNDATION.handlers['open.probe'] (1 round, 0.2 energy, never a material trial) or FOREST_BASE.handlers['forest.gather'] (1 round, 2 energy per unit, real stock and reach revalidated at transfer, exactly n units moved to an owned item). A person moves only inside that kernel step and at most once per round, so the step stays speed x dt / travel factor <= 0.8 along the observed route with the actual-obstacle check, the carried-mass effort and the swept-body checks of v7Step; each navigate step is first priced by running the same kernel step on a copy of the person, is not taken if it would pass the path, energy or reserve limit, must match that priced copy exactly, and a guard refuses any step above 0.8 (a 60-round test with everyone else rushing confirms no round moves anyone more than 0.8 and that the search moves only through one kernel moved or arrived event). Candidates come only from v7Observe (vision 5) and the person's own memory of sources out of view: objects with data.resource equal to the named resource whose centre is within the radius of the origin (default the person's position), with stock of at least one unit, not created by another person and not blocked in this run, nearest straight-line gap to interaction reach first; sources currently seen with zero stock are recorded as seen facts and not visited; only when no stocked source is known may it walk to an observed, dry, obstacle-free cell inside the radius from which unseen cells of the area lie within vision, never to unseen ground; a known stocked source that cannot fit the lower bounds of reach, inspection and one unit stops the search with the binding limit instead of walking on. It completes at the quantity or when no stocked source and no unseen ground remain (an honest result with zero units is possible), and stops before any step at the path limit, the time limit (every world round since the start, paused ones included), the energy budget, the energy reserve or an unsafe state (health <= 60, satiety <= 8, body temperature 10 or more from 22, or an injury in the last round, the kernel's own urgent-risk lines). Another action, a refused round or a simultaneous conflict pauses it after the environment, resume rechecks everything and inspects again before any harvest, cancel ends it in one round at no cost, death ends it through onDeath and carried units follow the ordinary death rules once; one open search per person; nothing is held in escrow, refunded, created or eaten. Modeling assumptions: the probe's observed stock counts exposed ripe units; one gather takes min(stock, quantity left, units the budget and reserve allow) in its own single round, as a person could; there is no carrying limit beyond navigate's carried-mass cost; plants carry no owner, so only sources created by another person are treated as theirs; the travel-cost order and the feasibility test use the straight-line gap, 0.8 per round and 2 energy per distance as lower bounds of navigate's route and travel factor; a navigate failure such as goal-overlap leaves that target out for the run and uses the round; the parameter maxima are radius 8, path 16, time 40, energy 40 and quantity 20. No reward: every event carries this interface, so no satisfaction rule matches, practiceEvidence is the completed event without a qualified flag, and open-experience.ts gates routine and progress accounting by this revision so that a search round counts exactly as the same navigate, probe or gather step by hand (tested against a manual run and an idle run). The ability serializes to 2819 code units (limit 3500), every earlier package is byte-identical by its id@version digest, and the ex25 heat-exposure test now asserts that it is the last long-ex25 package rather than the last package overall.
